name: Instagram Broadcast Channel
strategic_objective: Direct distribution, community updates, exclusive drops, and high-signal communication with followers who opted in.

tone: Direct, personal, and concise. Feels like a founder or brand insider speaking, not a marketing broadcast.
copywriting_rules: Keep messages short and high-value. Each message should communicate one update, one announcement, or one insight. Avoid long-form storytelling. Prioritize clarity and immediacy.
Mentions can be used sparingly to highlight collaborators or featured creators.

hard_constraints: Posting full-length captions from feed posts without adaptation
Using the channel as a high-frequency promo dump
Multiple competing CTAs in a single update
